about_text: Friday Night Funkin': Vs Sonic.EXE (Unofficial) is a fan-made project inspired by the iconic 2021 Vs. Sonic.EXE mod. Created to capture the dark atmosphere and nostalgia of the original, this project recovers part of the cancelled content with new reinterpretations of its story, songs, and characters.
warning_text: This mod contains <red>flashing lights</red>, disturbing images, and visual effects that may cause discomfort or <red>epileptic seizures</red>. Viewer discretion is advised.
